accuracy_notes: Source is a generic stylised deer. The build script fixes what reads wrong for a Sierra foothill black-tailed doe: ears enlarged 1.3x (mule and black-tailed deer have big ears), grey-brown coat with a darker forehead and nose bridge, small dark almond eye, tail black on top and at the tip and white beneath, a clean white rump patch. Open: no buck (black-tailed bucks carry mule-deer forked antlers); the bedded pose still looks sunk into the ground; the low-poly faceting is stylised rather than realistic. A local naturalist should check tail, rump and ear proportions against does seen in the foothills.
